title: ERASER: A Benchmark to Evaluate Rationalized NLP Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a benchmark to evaluate the interpretability of NLP models by assessing how well their provided 'rationales' (supporting evidence) align with human-annotated rationales. The tasks are standard NLP tasks such as sentiment analysis, question answering, and natural language inference. There is no component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
